title: Sparkly red car
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Sparkles -->
  <g fill='#FFE066'>
    <!-- sparkle top left -->
    <path d='M18 20 L20 26 L26 28 L20 30 L18 36 L16 30 L10 28 L16 26 Z'/>
    <!-- sparkle top right -->
    <path d='M82 14 L84 20 L90 22 L84 24 L82 30 L80 24 L74 22 L80 20 Z'/>
    <!-- sparkle small mid-left -->
    <path d='M8 50 L9.5 54 L13.5 55.5 L9.5 57 L8 61 L6.5 57 L2.5 55.5 L6.5 54 Z'/>
    <!-- sparkle small mid-right -->
    <path d='M92 46 L93.5 50 L97.5 51.5 L93.5 53 L92 57 L90.5 53 L86.5 51.5 L90.5 50 Z'/>
    <!-- sparkle bottom -->
    <path d='M70 82 L71.5 86 L75.5 87.5 L71.5 89 L70 93 L68.5 89 L64.5 87.5 L68.5 86 Z'/>
    <!-- tiny dot sparkles -->
    <circle cx='30' cy='10' r='2'/>
    <circle cx='76' cy='72' r='2'/>
    <circle cx='12' cy='76' r='1.8'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Car body shadow -->
  <rect x='14' y='58' width='72' height='18' rx='6' fill='#8B1A1A'/>

  <!-- Car body main -->
  <rect x='12' y='54' width='76' height='20' rx='6' fill='#E03030'/>

  <!-- Car roof/cabin -->
  <path d='M30 40 L38 28 L66 28 L74 40 Z' fill='#E03030'/>
  <!-- Roof highlight -->
  <path d='M34 40 L40 30 L64 30 L70 40 Z' fill='#F25050'/>

  <!-- Windshield -->
  <path d='M40 31 L45 39 L62 39 L66 31 Z' fill='#A8D8F0'/>
  <path d='M42 33 L46 38 L58 38 L61 33 Z' fill='#D0EEFF'/>

  <!-- Side windows -->
  <rect x='68' y='32' width='6' height='7' rx='1' fill='#A8D8F0'/>
  <rect x='28' y='32' width='6' height='7' rx='1' fill='#A8D8F0'/>

  <!-- Door line -->
  <line x1='50' y1='41' x2='50' y2='72' stroke='#B02020' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <!-- Headlight -->
  <ellipse cx='86' cy='60' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#FFE066'/>
  <ellipse cx='86' cy='60' rx='2.5' ry='3.5' fill='#FFF5B0'/>

  <!-- Taillight -->
  <ellipse cx='14' cy='60' rx='3' ry='4' fill='#FF6060'/>

  <!-- Front bumper detail -->
  <rect x='80' y='68' width='8' height='3' rx='1' fill='#C02525'/>

  <!-- Wheels -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='76' r='9' fill='#3A3A4A'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='76' r='5' fill='#8080A0'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='76' r='2' fill='#C0C0D8'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='76' r='9' fill='#3A3A4A'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='76' r='5' fill='#8080A0'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='76' r='2' fill='#C0C0D8'/>

  <!-- Bottom highlight -->
  <rect x='16' y='70' width='68' height='2' rx='1' fill='#F25050' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- Grille -->
  <rect x='82' y='63' width='5' height='2' rx='0.5' fill='#C02525'/>
  <rect x='82' y='66' width='5' height='2' rx='0.5' fill='#C02525'/>
</svg>
